# Vivek Sharma | Frontend Engineer Delivery

Portfolio and resume of Vivek Sharma, a frontend engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications for enterprise clients such as Tata Motors and Maruti Suzuki. Expert in React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frontend development.
